description:
Welcome to Tech Habba 2.0

One Fest. Countless Ideas. Infinite Possibilities.
Tech Habba 2.0 is a National-Level Technical Fest hosted at Acharya Institutes, Bengaluru, from November 19–21, 2026. Bringing together students, developers, and innovators from across India, the fest celebrates technology, creativity, and collaboration.
The Experience
Explore 13 exciting technical and non-technical events, compete with talented participants, and showcase your skills. Participate in a 24-hour hackathon where ideas transform into working prototypes and innovative solutions.
Hackathon Tracks
- Autonomous Systems: Build intelligent autonomous solutions and AI-powered agents.
- Voice & Multimodal AI: Create applications using voice, text, images, and other modalities.
- Healthcare: Develop technology-driven healthcare solutions.
- Mobility: Innovate for transportation and smarter mobility.
- Cybersecurity: Strengthen digital security and address cyber threats.
What to Expect
- 13 technical and non-technical events
- ₹1,25,000 prize pool
- 24-hour hackathon and project showcases
- Innovation, teamwork, and hands-on learning
- Networking and opportunities for recognition
Who Can Participate?
Students from colleges and universities across India are welcome. Hackathon teams must consist of 2–4 members.
Our Mission
To empower young minds to explore emerging technologies, collaborate on meaningful challenges, and transform creative ideas into practical solutions.
Be Part of the Innovation!
Bring your ideas, showcase your talent, and experience three days of technology, competition, creativity, and fun at Tech Habba 2.0.
Venue: Acharya Institutes, Bengaluru
Dates: November 19–21, 2026
Total Events: 13
Hackathon Duration: 24 hours
Team Size: 2–4 members
Prize Pool: ₹1,25,000
